correctness.rationale: Equation (2) is the finite Markov hitting probability recurrence. A strict superharmonic (K/lambda)^|S| gives order control, enabling a rigorous finite-state induction to the first-passage inverse-cut recursion and an O(lambda^-1) relative error. Renewal at the all-infected state gives the exact asymptotic coefficient; all excursions have mean O(lambda^-1). The pinned-coordinate integration over order chambers has unimodular Jacobian and yields C_G, and tree differences factor into (1/w_uv+1/w_vu). Adding positive arcs strictly lowers the positive integral. An independently replayed exact-rational checker passed 1576 comparisons.

value.rationale: This exact all-orders and all-trees leading survival law replaces exponential state-matrix inversion by a local edge product and yields an unexpected topological invariance; heterogeneous directional contact and recovery rates remain fully explicit. The strict edge-addition effect and edge-reciprocal formula are natural benchmarks for finite-network epidemic persistence and experimentally checkable finite-state models, without extrapolating to clinical outcomes.
